controls: in the companion main manifest; this set deliberately holds only the high indeterminacy region and must be read alongside it
scope: Procedurally generated dimensioned structural elevations of planar building frames, generation and editing, ordered by degree of static indeterminacy. Not general 3D CAD.
rationale: Concentrated at indeterminacy 9 and above, where the 20 September pilot recorded its only failure. The pilot families ordered 0 (pass), 3 (pass), 9 (fail).

criteria.selection: Three completed non-truncated samples all showing the same substantive analysis or geometry error. Format-only, missing output, API and token-budget failures are excluded rather than counted as failures.
